Metadata:
https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/model.json

## USE

    whisper-cli -m ggml-small.en.bin -f audio.wav

The repository contains model data only. Supply the runtime separately.

## ACTIONS ARTIFACT

Workflow: `Update Whisper small.en offline model`
Artifact: `openai-whisper-small-en-ggml-<model-sha-prefix>`
Contents:
- `ggml-small.en.bin`
- `ggml-small.en.bin.sha256`
- `ggml-small.en.manifest.json`
Retention: 90 days.

Use this artifact when direct binary release download is unavailable.

## UPDATE

The workflow is manual-only.

New model:
1. Resolve OpenAI `small.en.pt` URL and SHA-256.
2. Download and verify the checkpoint.
3. Package the PyTorch ZIP.
4. Convert with `ggml-org/whisper.cpp/models/convert-pt-to-ggml.py`.
5. Publish release files and Actions artifact.

Existing model:
- Missing GGML: recover the verified checkpoint from the existing release ZIP and convert it.
- GGML present: reuse release files and refresh the Actions artifact.
